mentions.name: Dumpling Money
mentions.description: A personal finance app for reviewing a family's transactions, viewing cash flow, and tracking net worth, built as an alternative to restrictive, expensive, or envelope-budgeting apps like YNAB. Its only AI feature is opt-in, using Jev AI to auto-categorize transactions that are stripped of identifying info.
mentions.problem: Existing budgeting apps are restrictive, expensive, or envelope (YNAB) focused; the author wanted a personal finance app to review family transactions, cash flow, and net worth rather than a budget app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I don't really need a "budget" app, more of a personal finance app. I just want to be able to review all my family's transactions and look at cash flow and track net worth, so I built my own.

evidence.value: I don't really need a "budget" app, more of a personal finance app. I just want to be able to review all my family's transactions and look at cash flow and track net worth, so I built my own.
